Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.22.2 applies tank recoil on the successful shot frame after drive integration, limits the T-34 gun to -5/+25 degrees, explodes every first physical shell impact regardless of range, and restores finite armored durability with Hitpoints=1 and AttackResilience=600 while retaining fire immunity. v0.22.1 two-seat input/seat fixes and v0.22 multiplayer driving remain included. Remote tank fire stays server-validated; ordinary clients never create explosive shells. Existing crops, ecology, creatures, furniture and vehicle resources remain included. Android/7723 behavior is pending real-device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
